messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system Saturday 7 March
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The DMS will be unavailable from 18:00 Saturday 7 March until 02:00 Sunday 8 March for a storage upgrade. Please check in any open documents before close on Friday. Email and the case-management system are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
